source: hand-authored fixture for issue #296 — not shipped data
description: A curated entry whose display NAME and only alias are a combining acute accent and nothing else. It is the one string DrugReferenceValidity's two alias rules used to disagree about: the drop rung asks namesAnything, which folds diacritics away and finds no letter or digit, so the alias goes; the repair rung asked only whether normalizeName(name) is non-blank, which a combining mark is, so it put the same string straight back as an alias. The loaded entry then answered isNamed true and matchesDrugName false for that string — the disagreement DrugReference.setAliases' trim exists to make impossible, surviving the trim because folding empties the needle rather than the stored value. The second entry is the control: same file, an ordinary name, must be untouched.
